foundations.author: Vincent Boucher, MONTREAL.AI
substantive_result: Separates intent charter I=(D,U,C,A,B), formulation F=(R,K,Q,Pi,nu), and evaluation instrument E. A useful transformation changes a binding instrumental restriction while preserving authorized purpose, obligations and permissions.

Finite two-world causal example: passive observations have identical distributions, so passive classification cannot exceed 1/2; a permitted active intervention policy with m=12 achieves 8191/8192 accuracy, at most 12 queries and expected 6.999755859375 queries.
An unrestricted conventional Bellman planner matches the result. This is a supplied synthetic exact example, not autonomous frontier-model discovery, a new causal theorem or natural-work validation.

Allows bounded complementary exploration even when each component has no isolated immediate value; requires complete search, construction, confirmation, migration, execution, verification and maintenance cost.

foundations.title: Invent the Economy: Transformational Intelligence for Creating Viable Markets
foundations.author: Vincent Boucher, MONTREAL.AI
substantive_result: The invention object is a technical capability plus a voluntarily acceptable commercial arrangement, financing/delivery sequence, rights and evidence.
Five claims remain separate: technical possibility; modeled viability; accepted arrangement; realized exchange; repeatable market.

Shared-construction scenario: four hypothetical buyers, success price 300k each, buyer value 360k, delivery 75k each, common construction 600k, common success probability 0.8. Success contribution 300k, expected contribution 120k and required prefunding 900k. These are supplied exact-model inputs.
Three buyers produce positive success contribution 75k but expected contribution -60k; common failure loses 600k. Extra route fee 40k per buyer makes expected contribution -8k.
Exact 2240-case parameter grid admits 540, rejects 1700. The grid is software/model coverage, not estimated frequency of viable real businesses.
A profitable successor can remain unfundable: retained 300k surplus cannot fund a 450k cash prefix; a supplied core-cost reduction changes financing feasibility.
corrections_to_preserve: Customer value, price, contribution, operating profit, cash, refundable obligations and available funds have separate meanings.
Buyer participation cap q <= min(budget, value - adoption_cost / success_probability) is a feasibility condition, not a full equilibrium or proof of truthful private valuations.
Shared technical failure is correlated; diversification across buyers does not remove common-core risk.
A conventional unrestricted entrepreneur receives the same coordination and pricing options.
Settlement volume and productive surplus do not establish token price; route costs may eliminate viability. Token holders do not automatically hold enterprise profit rights.
No old modeled profit or hypothetical buyer value may be imported into a new offering.
foundations.application: Jointly test the bounded battery offering and conditional-commitment/pricing arrangement, including outside option, verification, shared failure, capacity, refunds and working-capital timing.
